basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast who recently discovered Reddit while troubleshooting a motherboard issue with my ASRock setup. I live in Salt Lake City and spend my weekends hiking in Zion National Park. I'm a software developer by trade, currently single, and enjoy building LEGO sets in my downtime. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to 10 PM local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a degree from a local university. Most of my tech knowledge comes from a mix of formal education and self-driven projects, particularly in custom PC building and software development.
